title: Aaron Donald plans to play vs. Giants; Puka Nacua sits out Rams practice

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Aaron Donald plans to play vs. Giants; Puka Nacua sits out Rams practice
sources.description: Aaron Donald didn't commit 100% to playing for the Rams against the Giants, but he says he's planning on it. Puka Nacua is dealing with a hip injury.
